A SENTENCE OF THIS MANUSCRIPT HAD BEEN FALSE FOR SIX LAPS AND THE CORRECTION LANDED; AND THE AMENDMENT LAP 29 ORDERED THIS LAP TO LAND WAS BASED ON A WRONG INFERENCE, WHICH THE INDEPENDENT REVIEWER PROVED FROM LAP 29'S OWN ARTIFACT. body_words 8998 -> 8995, margin 2 -> 5: the document is SHORTER than it started and the next lap inherits more headroom than this one found, the first time since lap 12. Nothing carrying a caveat was compressed and no registered number was traded. (1) THE FALSE SENTENCE. SS5's coupling paragraph ended 'That the surface itself goes unchecked is the first limitation in Section 6'. FALSE since paper lap 24 incorporated docs/oracle_gap.md SS4 (IoU 0.3941: 952 predicted, 937 observed, 534 in both) and doubly so since lap 29's window brought docs/disc_null.md, which scored the same field against an AREA-MATCHED DISC at the ignition and against the burn's own centre-of-mass movement. The surface is checked; it has been checked twice; the manuscript said it was not. It now reads 'What that surface is worth against observed burn is Section 6's first limitation'. WHY NINE LAPS READ PAST IT: the sentence is a CROSS-REFERENCE, a paraphrase of SS6's own heading, and that heading ('the ROUTING RESULT is graded against the predicted field') is still true today. The paraphrase stopped being true when the FIELD acquired an external grade. No number moved, no registered spelling covers it, and no gate here can tell a claim from a paraphrase of one. (2) THE AMENDMENT LAP 29 ORDERED WAS WRONG. Lap 29's ledger closes its SS6 finding 'A THIRTIETH LAP MUST NOT RECORD THIS A SECOND TIME WITHOUT LANDING IT' on the reasoning that 'THE OVERSHOOT BREAKS THAT SYMMETRY AGAINST THE PAPER, making the first branch the measured one'. THAT IS FALSE AND data/processed/disc_null_yeongdeok.json - THE ARTIFACT LAP 29 ITSELF SHIPPED - IS THE DISPROOF, read this lap on the reviewer's instruction with one json.load and no rerun: model false alarms against model misses run 262/507 at 180 min, 418/403 at the headline 360 min, 438/394 at 540 and 460/411 at 720. At the headline the two error classes are THE SAME SIZE TO WITHIN 4 PERCENT, and at the earliest slice MISSES ARE NEARLY DOUBLE FALSE ALARMS, favouring the SECOND reading two to one. Nowhere does the first branch dominate. THE DEFECT IS A HALF-STATED MECHANISM and this lap wrote it out in full in its own first draft: 'overshoot produces predicted-but-unburned cells' is half of what overshoot does - the model's core mass travels 7.292 cells while the burn's travels 2.250, so moving the mass out there puts cells where nothing burned AND ABANDONS THE CELLS NEAR THE SEED THAT DID. Both branches from one displacement. TWO FURTHER REVIEWER OBJECTIONS AGAINST THE DRAFT CLAUSE, BOTH SOUND: (a) it drew a ROUTING-RESULT inference from a document that expressly disclaims one (the dn_yeongdeok_ band opens 'A FLOOR FOR ONE METRIC ON ONE FIRE, NOT A VALIDATION AND NOT A ROUTING RESULT' and docs/disc_null.md SS5.3 says it in its own voice), in a lap whose ledger quotes SS5.3 approvingly one clause later; (b) the same paragraph's GAP marker names the run that would settle it and it has not been run, so ASSERTING AN UNMEASURED LEAN IS A FABRICATED LIMITATION UNDER CHARTER SS3 RULE 5 EVEN WHEN THE FABRICATION RUNS AGAINST THE PAPER - harder to catch precisely because it is self-critical, and GAPS.md G7 applies the same rule in the opposite direction. WHAT SS6 SAYS INSTEAD, and it is a better sentence than the one ordered: 'a floor comparison of that field against observed burn SEPARATES NEITHER READING: the predicted core holds the burn's shape and extent far better than an equal-area disc at the ignition, but its centre of mass overshoots where the disc's does not (docs/disc_null.md). No control on the routing result admits external truth.' It quotes NO NUMBER, which is the registry's requirement and not a dodge (the band binds six facts to any quotation and DIRECTION.md bars 2.5360 and the pair 0.3941/0.1554 without 2.2044 and 0.2577/0.1169 beside them); it carries BOTH caveats that scope the CLAIM rather than the numbers ('a FLOOR comparison', SS5.1; and BOTH HALVES OF THE PAIRING, SS4's rule being symmetric in both directions); and 'separates neither reading' hands the question straight to the GAP marker two sentences later, where it belongs. THE CONTROL SENTENCE LOST ITS MECHANISM RATHER THAN GAINING A NARROWER ONE, also the reviewer's finding: the draft narrowed 'Every control HERE' to 'on the routing result', turning a vague deictic into an explicit universal WITHOUT RE-CHECKING IT AGAINST SS4.6, where the flat-timing control, the budget sweep, the slope-sampling sweep and the OpenStreetMap re-acquisition are all controls on the routing result that perturb something other than the predicted field. The load-bearing half is true of every one of them, so the sentence is now 'No control on the routing result admits external truth' (-3 on the original) and the false mechanism is GONE rather than narrowed. This is NOT lap 24's 'deleting a false justification while keeping the conclusion': that conclusion was unproven, this one was checked control by control against SS3.5 and SS4.6 before the mechanism was dropped.
